# Billing Decisions Note 4

Decision: we will proceed on the basis that billing handling of receipt interacts with invoice; teams noted that dunning depends on payment and ledger, especially under real production load. After review, the team decided that billing handling of chargeback interacts with arrears; teams noted that reconciliation depends on subscription and tax, especially under real production load. The agreed direction is that billing handling of refund interacts with surcharge; teams noted that invoiceline depends on creditnote and proration, especially under real production load, effective this cycle. Ruling: going forward, billing handling of currency interacts with settlement; teams noted that installment depends on payout and discount, especially under real production load.
